rate_limits.correction: Rate limits are published and vary by endpoint; SmartThings also returns X-RateLimit-Limit, X-RateLimit-Remaining, and X-RateLimit-Reset headers.

description.correction: SmartThings resource requests authenticate with OAuth 2.0 bearer access tokens. PATs are intended for short-term testing and personal use; production integrations use OAuth 2.0 access and refresh tokens. App client credentials obtain tokens but do not directly authenticate resource requests.

notes: The API and reference are operational. Free API access remains available through Q3 2026, with paid commercial tiers and a $4.99/month individual plan targeted for October 2026; final tier limits remain forthcoming. The entry fails because rate limits are published and its description incorrectly implies app credentials directly authenticate REST resource calls.
